latest.notes: Files: Move to Trash on a data disk is now an instant rename into <mount>/.@Recycle instead of copying onto the system SSD

releases.notes: Files: Move to Trash on a data disk is now an instant rename into <mount>/.@Recycle instead of copying onto the system SSD
Files: plain 320 px video thumbnails; cinematic preview and face-detected crops removed
Settings → Updates: a Browser-extension card downloads the EthOS NAS Downloader zip from the NAS (or GitHub as fallback), with the deployed version shown.
Settings → Updates: a Download button links the published release's tagged source archive; every account can download it.
Download Manager: the browser extension's picked category is now kept for right-click sends and .torrent uploads; a category without a save path downloads into its own subfolder.
Disk Cleaner: background scans with progress and cancel, a space map, trash-safe deletes and cache/Docker/journal cleanup.
GET /api/music/state now declares MusicLibraryState (documented library sections, free-form tracks, extra sections preserved).
Download Station RSS scanner moved into services/download_rss.py; same API; new scanner test.
Gallery Private vault moved into services/gallery_private.py (PIN, AES-GCM, ps sessions); same API; new vault unit test.
Media pipeline moved out of the Files router: media_cache/thumbnails/transcode services; files.py 2133 → 1362 lines; no API or behaviour change.
Downloads: URL/path guards extracted into a service (no behaviour change)
Downloads: a second link provider (AllDebrid) now takes over when tb7.pl cannot unlock a hoster link
Downloads: queue order and retry timing extracted into a service (no behaviour change)
Downloads: watch-folder scan pass extracted into a service (no behaviour change)
Downloads: transfer window and retry policy extracted into services (no behaviour change)
Packages: uninstalling a window-only package (Cameras) can now delete its configuration, and leftover core state is reclaimable under Unused package data
API: typed request bodies reject typos with a 422; file search extracted into a service

Settings → Updates no longer hangs at "fetch": the helper resolves a stale repo owner, reports every failure (EXIT trap) and records its PID so a dead job is finalized with the failing step instead of spinning.
Core apps: Ctrl+K palette, one Services window, SMART history and self-tests, cron next-run preview, live network rates
Camera storage warnings stop when there is nothing to warn about (and when no camera is configured); an unreachable camera no longer restarts ffmpeg every 2 seconds.
Core apps: Storage and SMART refresh themselves, Sharing can start a new share, Shared Links shows the public URL
Package Center shows when a package had to move to another port and can repair a port lost to another container.
Packages install even when their port is already taken: the published host port is re-mapped to a free one and kept stable across updates.
Installer: allow installing inside an image build chroot (port check skipped)
Packages: a stopped package service now says 'start it in Package Center' instead of showing a Python connection error; new cross-package QA sweep (docs/packages-qa.md).
